title: Is ALPS Equal Sector Weight ETF (EQL) a Strong ETF Right Now?
author: Na
description: EQL is a smart beta ETF launched in 2009 that provides broad exposure to large-cap equities with equal weighting across sectors. With $758.22 million in assets and a 0.19% expense ratio, it has delivered 11.24% returns year-to-date and 13.21% over the past year. However, cheaper alternatives like VOO and IVV with lower expense ratios (0.03%) may be more suitable for investors seeking traditional market-cap weighted exposure.

However, the article suggests cheaper alternatives exist, limiting its appeal.

IVV is highlighted as a superior alternative with significantly lower expense ratio (0.03%), substantially larger assets ($860.27 billion), and lower risk profile, making it more attractive for cost-conscious investors.
